has sequence coordinates

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSequenceCoordinates
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Links a sequence feature to its frame-relative coordinates. Non-functional: competing coordinate claims from different assemblies or alignment methods coexist as evidence (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SequenceFeature -> gmeow:SequenceCoordinates

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates from gmeow:SequenceFeature to gmeow:SequenceCoordinates when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:SequenceFeature, gmeow:SequenceCoordinates

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to link a sequence feature to its frame-relative coordinates; non-functional, so claims from different assemblies coexist.

Avoid when

  • Avoid forcing one assembly's coordinates as canonical (Principle 9).

How to use

  • Point gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates at a SequenceCoordinates carrying start, end, strand, and gmeow:inReferenceAssembly.

Examples

  • ex:brca1 gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates ex:brca1Coords.
